---
title: "Guides"
---

Choose a guide by task. For installation, start with the [Quickstart](../quickstart.qmd).

| Guide | What do you need to do? |
| --- | --- |
| [01. Filter fundamentals](semantics.qmd) | Choose a window, handle NaNs, or check boundary rules. |
| [02. Convolution and smoothing](convolution.qmd) | Smooth an image, propagate variance, or apply a matched filter. |
| [03. Savitzky-Golay filters](savgol.qmd) | Fit a local polynomial or estimate a derivative. |
| [04. Build kernels](kernels.qmd) | Make Gaussian, Moffat, ring, or custom weights. |
| [05. Robust statistics](robust.qmd) | Estimate percentiles, MAD, or sigma-clipped statistics. |
| [06. Variable window means](variable.qmd) | Change the window size at each pixel. |
| [07. Edges and morphology](morphology.qmd) | Detect edges or apply grey morphology. |
| [08. Repair bad pixels](fixpix.qmd) | Interpolate over known bad pixels. |
| [09. Estimate sky background](background-tutorial.qmd) | [Fit the sky](background-tutorial.qmd#fit-the-background-and-rms-maps) or [compare SEP, Photutils, and ndfiltrs](background-tutorial.qmd#compare-each-map-with-the-truth). |
| [10. Background mesh settings](background.qmd) | [Choose mesh settings](background.qmd#reference-settings) or inspect interpolation differences. |
| [11. Filter benchmarks](benchmarks.qmd) | Compare measured runtimes for filters and background maps. |
